command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first.

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== the slide and mask must have arrived from RODA =="
# A truncated 546 MB stage-in would otherwise surface as an opaque openslide error.
for f in tumor_091.tif tumor_091_mask.tif tumor_091.xml; do
  test -s "/tmp/$f" || { echo "FAIL: /tmp/$f missing or empty"; exit 1; }
  printf '  %-22s %12s bytes\n' "$f" "$(stat -c %s "/tmp/$f")"
done

# python3 -u so a killed run still has its output in command.log.
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
